recap.text: The third recap introduces a hundred and fifty armed men from Africa. A boss battle follows. Whole factions arrive in the story as segments.

A special edition shows a city boss with crab pincers kill forty crawlers. Hekla, a massive slug, a four-armed Kabaddi Raider, Carl, Donut, and Lucia Mar appear. A clip of an old Primal with angel wings and a lightning sword fades before he dies. A montage shows Mongo killing street urchins while Donut sleeps. A crawler with an alligator head and a mag-fed shotgun appears, and Donut wonders how he wears a T-shirt.

The broadcast keeps track of the crawl through Elle, Li Jun, Ifechi, Florin, Miriam Dom, Prepotente, Hekla and Lucia Mar. A tribute to the death of Hekla shows her leaving a husband poisoned by a cactus and killing a rat with his rib for a Legendary Grrl Power box. Eva kills a man who grabbed Katia and leaves character creation while Katia transforms. Katia kills Hekla with a plough.

The recap shows a fight on a falling house. Prepotente and Miriam Dom scaled their bubble's inner wall and sent every spider plummeting in its sleep. Lucia Mar shatters a multi-limbed ice mummy. Quan Ch popped his bubble and flies around farming every mob. Lucia Mar is first in the top ten, followed by Carl, Prepotente, and Donut, while Florin the crocodilian dropped off.

Most of the recap is redacted. Surviving images show an undead Easter Bunny stuffing limbs into plastic eggs, a sentient umbrella chasing a group in Tokyo before a bus wipes them out, Elle beating and flagging a sasquatch, and Prepotente flagging a giant bat. Prime Minister Glory, boss of the Syndicate, appears as a gleener beside Kevin. The top ten barely moves.

beats.headline: It introduces you to your rivals
beats.text: The third recap brings in a hundred and fifty armed men from Africa, and then a boss battle. Whole factions arrive in the story as segments.
beats.gist: The third recap brings one hundred and fifty armed men from Africa and a boss battle.

beats.headline: Special Edition: the races
beats.text: A special edition shows what the favourite crawlers chose. First a demon-like city boss with crab pincers kills about forty crawlers in seconds. Then Hekla, a man who became a massive slug, a four-armed Kabaddi Raider, Carl, Donut, and Lucia Mar to close. Just about 80 per cent of crawlers have stayed human. A clip of an old Primal with wispy angel wings and a lightning sword, charging a twelfth-floor Divine Guardian, fades before the fight. Mordecai says he died a minute afterwards.
beats.gist: A special edition shows favorite crawlers, including a crab-pincered city boss and a slug-man named Hekla.

beats.headline: Fifteen seconds of Mongo
beats.text: The recap airs a fifteen-second montage of Mongo guarding a sleeping Donut, killing dozens of street urchins. Carl gets a few seconds and no explanation of how he got out of the circus: that scene belongs to the Vengeance of the Daughter production, Mordecai says, and anyone looking at Carl's numbers already knows. The same episode is following a crawler with an alligator head and a mag-fed shotgun that never seems to need reloading. Donut wants to know how he gets a T-shirt over that head.
beats.gist: The recap airs Mongo killing street urchins while Donut sleeps; Donut questions an alligator-headed crawler's T-shirt.

beats.headline: The board, two hours in
beats.text: Elle, Li Jun, Ifechi, Florin, Miriam Dom, Prepotente, Hekla and Lucia Mar, all in one broadcast. It is how the crawl keeps track of itself.
beats.gist: Elle, Li Jun, Ifechi, Florin, Miriam Dom, Prepotente, Hekla and Lucia Mar appear in one broadcast.

beats.headline: A tribute to Hekla
beats.text: The whole recap is a tribute to the death of Hekla. It opens on her walking in, in street clothes, fighting with a husband who looks twenty years older; she leaves him poisoned by a cactus and comes back to find rats eating him, and kills one with his rib for a Legendary Grrl Power box. It shows Eva killing the man who grabbed Katia, and Eva leaving character creation on the third floor while Katia was still transforming. Then the plough, and Katia killing Hekla, cut as rage at being used rather than an accident.

beats.headline: Wall climbers and an absence
beats.text: The recap features the fight on the falling house. Prepotente and Miriam Dom are as far along as Carl's party: they scaled their bubble's inner wall, sent every spider plummeting in its sleep, finished the subterranean zone with it, and are preparing to go underwater. Lucia Mar shatters a multi-limbed ice mummy and is working with a group. Quan Ch has already popped his bubble and is flying around farming every mob he can find. The top ten: Lucia Mar first, Carl second, Prepotente third, Donut fourth. Florin the crocodilian has dropped off it.
beats.gist: The recap shows the fight on the falling house and the current top ten rankings.

beats.headline: Almost entirely redacted
beats.text: Almost the whole recap is redacted. What survives: an undead Easter Bunny stuffing crawlers' limbs into plastic eggs; a group in Tokyo chased by a sentient umbrella and wiped out by a bus; Elle beating a sasquatch half to death and flagging it; Prepotente flagging a giant bat single-handed. Then a studio with faces in little boxes, and nothing, for almost an hour. Mordecai spots a gleener beside Kevin: Prime Minister Glory, boss of the entire Syndicate, who very rarely appears on the show. Afterwards the top ten barely moves.
beats.gist: The recap is redacted except for an undead Easter Bunny, a sentient umbrella, and flagging feats.
